description: pg_snapshot and txid_snapshot canonical storage, visibility functions, set-returning xip access, catalogs, arrays, and protocol type inference
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_snapshot_values (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, captured pg_snapshot NOT NULL, legacy txid_snapshot NOT NULL, history pg_snapshot[] NOT NULL);
SELECT id, captured::text, legacy::text, history::text, pg_typeof(captured), pg_typeof(legacy) FROM type_matrix_snapshot_values ORDER BY id;
SELECT pg_snapshot_xmin(NULL::pg_snapshot), pg_snapshot_xmax(NULL::pg_snapshot), pg_visible_in_snapshot(NULL::xid8, '10:20:'::pg_snapshot), pg_visible_in_snapshot('11'::xid8, NULL::pg_snapshot);
SELECT oid, typname, typlen, typbyval, typalign, typstorage, typarray FROM pg_type WHERE typname IN ('pg_snapshot', 'txid_snapshot') ORDER BY oid;
SELECT captured FROM type_matrix_snapshot_values ORDER BY captured;
SELECT captured, count(*) FROM type_matrix_snapshot_values GROUP BY captured;
